meaning: The vessel component defaults `activate_resistance_evolution = 1`, so unless a caller overrides it, Poiseuille resistance is allowed to evolve with vessel state rather than staying fixed. It is a default on a component used across many vessels, not a per-case setting.

could_move.what: Every vessel instantiated without passing this keyword picks up the evolving-resistance branch, so venous/jugular pressure-flow curves shift
Jugular compression comparisons against patient data could change shape, since resistance evolution matters most when a vessel is collapsed
Cross-model comparison decks may become unfair if the models differ in whether they override this default
Fitted parameter values in the patient fits may absorb part of this default's effect
Bistability results may depend on it, as the resistance nonlinearity feeds the multiple-equilibria mechanism

expectation: Unknown. The sign and size depend on how the flag is used in the equations below line 148 and on how many call sites override it; I cannot tell from this context.

check.why: Re-solves one fitted case without a full re-fit, so a changed default shows up as a changed residual or trace.
